scope: Documented permission and provenance for the named model assets only. Not legal certification, third-party patent clearance, a complete dependency audit, or permission for arbitrary user-uploaded content. This check does not gate local inference.

condmdi.name: CondMDI author random-frames checkpoint
condmdi.summary: MIT code is documented. Commercial permission for the exact checkpoint and downstream outputs is unresolved; the training-data license is restrictive.

conditions: Retain copyright and permission notices; audit separate dependencies.

weights.detail: README grants MIT to code; no separate commercial checkpoint grant found in README or downloaded archive.

trainingData.detail: HumanML3D originates from AMASS/HumanAct12. AMASS prohibits commercial-use model training under its public dataset license. Downstream pretrained-weight implications require clarification; this is not a blanket determination about every output.

outputs.detail: Commercial generated-motion rights and any upstream obligations are not explicitly resolved in the reviewed model terms.

blockers: Obtain a written checkpoint commercial-use/distribution/output grant and resolve the upstream dataset permission chain, or replace this checkpoint with freshly trained cleared-data weights.

dart.name: DART / DartControl pretrained models
dart.summary: Authors explicitly license their code and model Apache-2.0 while retaining separate AMASS/SMPL obligations.

trainingData.detail: AMASS/BABEL/HumanML3D and SMPL-X/H retain their respective terms.

outputs.detail: Third-party body-model/data obligations and the intended output pipeline need clearance.

blockers: Not a verified commercial substitute until its exact checkpoint and body-model/data dependencies are cleared.

anytop.name: AnyTop published checkpoints
anytop.summary: Model repository expressly limits pretrained checkpoints to non-commercial research, separate from MIT code.

trainingData.detail: Truebones ZOO rights are not granted by model terms; processed data is withheld pending clarification.

outputs.detail: No commercial inference/output permission is established by research-only checkpoint terms.

unimate.name: UniMate published checkpoints
unimate.summary: Checkpoint license is CC-BY-NC-4.0; MIT applies separately to code.

trainingData.detail: License excludes third-party Truebones ZOO, Mixamo, and Objaverse-XL rights.

outputs.detail: Commercial checkpoint use is outside this published grant.

owned_humanoid.name: Still humanoid CC0 motion prior
owned_humanoid.summary: Fresh project-trained weights from the recorded author CC0 motion assets. This establishes an asset-permission path, not motion-quality or legal certification.

code.detail: Project-authored network/trainer/geometry; package dependency notices remain separate.

weights.detail: Fresh random initialization, no external pretrained model; exact trained artifact pinned above.

trainingData.detail: Only recorded author CC0 clips were used; train-only statistics, entire source clip identities held out.

outputs.detail: No additional project model-output restriction; copyright/data permission derives from the documented CC0 source. User inputs and unrelated third-party rights remain separate.

conditions: Preserve dependency notices when packaging code/libraries.
Do not silently mix restricted training data or pretrained weights into this model lineage.
Keep the source and training provenance with the exact checkpoint.
